svg.text: IPU v3 — KLayout placement view (Nangate45 + OpenRAM 16 KB 1R1W)
Die 1343 × 741 µm = 0.995 mm² · synthesized area 0.859 mm² (macro 0.787 + logic 0.071) · 38,688 standard cells at 65 % row utilization
score bank · 256 words × 512 bits = 16 KB · 1 write port + 1 read port
786,585 µm² = 0.787 mm² (91.6 % of the synthesized area)
outline only: area from the .lib, aspect ratio 1.6 assumed (no LEF/GDS supplied)
real Nangate45 cell layouts (active, poly, contacts,
metal1) in 1.4 µm rows, alternate rows flipped
What this picture is — and is not
Is: every cell from the Yosys/ABC Nangate45 netlist, placed legally on the 0.19 × 1.40 µm site grid, grouped by RTL block, drawn with the cells' real GDS; the OpenRAM macro at its real .lib area.
Is not: an OpenROAD place-and-route. No timing-driven placement, no clock tree, no routing between cells, no power grid beyond the cells' own rails, no pins, no DRC/LVS.
The macro is an outline because only its .lib/.v were supplied (its LEF/GDS would give the true shape and pins). Placement script: rtl/ipu_v3/syn/layout/make_placement_view.py.
Label it on a slide as "placement view (pre-P&R)", not "layout" or "die photo".
